#Grandma #donut #waternelon 
Join grandma and grandpa as they head to the watermelon field in the heart of the Azerbaijani village. They pick fresh, ripe watermelons, then return to bake delicious homemade donuts on the saj. After cooking, they sit down to enjoy hot tea and sweet watermelon in a peaceful countryside setting.

This relaxing village life video is full of authentic rural moments, traditional outdoor cooking, summer harvest beauty, and the simple joy of homemade food. If you love grandma cooking, grandpa village work, countryside traditions, and natural slow living, this video is for you.

In this video:

Watermelon harvesting in the village
Traditional saj donuts cooking
Tea time in nature
Fresh watermelon tasting
Authentic Azerbaijani rural life

Watch till the end to enjoy the calm atmosphere of village life, traditional cooking, and the warm daily routine of grandma and grandpa.
